name: 28 - API - Process Appointment Confirmation Response - Corrected V2

assignments.name: response_note
assignments.value: پاسخ بیمار به درخواست تأیید نوبت

parameters.query:
WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::TEXT AS confirmation_token,
        $2::TEXT AS mobile,
        $3::TEXT AS response,
        $4::TEXT AS response_note
),

request_context AS (
    SELECT
        confirmation.id AS confirmation_request_id,
        confirmation.appointment_id,
        confirmation.status AS confirmation_status,
        confirmation.expires_at,

        appointment.clinic_id,
        appointment.doctor_id,
        appointment.patient_id,
        appointment.service_id,
        appointment.starts_at,
        appointment.ends_at,
        appointment.status AS appointment_status,
        appointment.google_calendar_event_id,

        clinic.name AS clinic_name,
        clinic.timezone,

        doctor.full_name AS doctor_name,

        patient.full_name AS patient_name,
        patient.mobile,

        service.name AS service_name,

        r.response,
        r.response_note

    FROM appointment_confirmation_requests confirmation

    INNER JOIN appointments appointment
        ON appointment.id = confirmation.appointment_id

    INNER JOIN clinics clinic
        ON clinic.id = appointment.clinic_id

    INNER JOIN doctors doctor
        ON doctor.id = appointment.doctor_id

    INNER JOIN patients patient
        ON patient.id = appointment.patient_id

    LEFT JOIN services service
        ON service.id = appointment.service_id

    INNER JOIN request_data r
        ON r.confirmation_token =
           confirmation.confirmation_token
       AND r.mobile = patient.mobile

    WHERE confirmation.status = 'pending'

    LIMIT 1
),

expired_request AS (
    UPDATE appointment_confirmation_requests confirmation

    SET
        status = 'expired',
        responded_at = COALESCE(
            confirmation.responded_at,
            NOW()
        ),
        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM request_context context

    WHERE confirmation.id =
          context.confirmation_request_id

      AND context.expires_at <= NOW()

    RETURNING confirmation.id
),

confirmed_appointment AS (
    UPDATE appointments appointment

    SET
        status = 'confirmed',
        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM request_context context

    WHERE context.response = 'confirm'
      AND context.expires_at > NOW()
      AND appointment.id = context.appointment_id
      AND appointment.status IN ('pending', 'confirmed')
      AND appointment.starts_at > NOW()

    RETURNING
        appointment.id AS appointment_id,
        appointment.status
),

confirmed_request AS (
    UPDATE appointment_confirmation_requests confirmation

    SET
        status = 'confirmed',
        responded_at = NOW(),
        response_note = context.response_note,
        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM request_context context

    INNER JOIN confirmed_appointment appointment
        ON appointment.appointment_id =
           context.appointment_id

    WHERE confirmation.id =
          context.confirmation_request_id

    RETURNING confirmation.id
),

cancelled_appointment AS (
    UPDATE appointments appointment

    SET
        status = 'cancelled',

        cancellation_reason =
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(
                    context.response_note,
                    ''
                ),
                'لغو نوبت در پاسخ به یادآوری پیش از مراجعه'
            ),

        cancelled_at = NOW(),
        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM request_context context

    WHERE context.response = 'cancel'
      AND context.expires_at > NOW()
      AND appointment.id = context.appointment_id
      AND appointment.status IN ('pending', 'confirmed')
      AND appointment.starts_at > NOW()

    RETURNING
        appointment.id AS appointment_id,
        appointment.status,
        appointment.cancellation_reason
),

cancelled_request AS (
    UPDATE appointment_confirmation_requests confirmation

    SET
        status = 'cancelled',
        responded_at = NOW(),
        response_note = context.response_note,
        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM request_context context

    INNER JOIN cancelled_appointment appointment
        ON appointment.appointment_id =
           context.appointment_id

    WHERE confirmation.id =
          context.confirmation_request_id

    RETURNING confirmation.id
),

reschedule_request AS (
    UPDATE appointment_confirmation_requests confirmation

    SET
        status = 'reschedule_requested',
        responded_at = NOW(),
        response_note = context.response_note,
        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM request_context context

    WHERE context.response = 'reschedule'
      AND context.expires_at > NOW()
      AND confirmation.id =
          context.confirmation_request_id

      AND context.appointment_status IN (
          'pending',
          'confirmed'
      )

      AND context.starts_at > NOW()

    RETURNING confirmation.id
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM request_context
        )
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM expired_request
        )
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN r.response = 'confirm'
             AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM confirmed_request
             )
            THEN TRUE

        WHEN r.response = 'cancel'
             AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM cancelled_request
             )
            THEN TRUE

        WHEN r.response = 'reschedule'
             AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM reschedule_request
             )
            THEN TRUE

        ELSE FALSE
    END AS success,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM request_context
        )
            THEN 'confirmation_request_not_found'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM expired_request
        )
            THEN 'confirmation_request_expired'

        WHEN r.response = 'confirm'
             AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM confirmed_request
             )
            THEN 'appointment_confirmed'

        WHEN r.response = 'cancel'
             AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM cancelled_request
             )
            THEN 'appointment_cancelled'

        WHEN r.response = 'reschedule'
             AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM reschedule_request
             )
            THEN 'reschedule_requested'

        ELSE 'confirmation_response_conflict'
    END AS result,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM request_context
        )
            THEN 'درخواست تأیید فعال مطابق توکن و شماره موبایل پیدا نشد.'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM expired_request
        )
            THEN 'زمان اعتبار درخواست تأیید به پایان رسیده است.'

        WHEN r.response = 'confirm'
             AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM confirmed_request
             )
            THEN 'حضور بیمار برای نوبت تأیید شد.'

        WHEN r.response = 'cancel'
             AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM cancelled_request
             )
            THEN 'نوبت بیمار لغو شد.'

        WHEN r.response = 'reschedule'
             AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM reschedule_request
             )
            THEN 'درخواست جابه‌جایی بیمار ثبت شد؛ باید زمان‌های آزاد به او پیشنهاد شود.'

        ELSE 'وضعیت نوبت یا درخواست تأیید در فاصله بررسی تا ثبت پاسخ تغییر کرده است.'
    END AS message,

    r.response AS action,

    (
        SELECT confirmation_request_id
        FROM request_context
    ) AS confirmation_request_id,

    (
        SELECT appointment_id
        FROM request_context
    ) AS appointment_id,

    (
        SELECT patient_name
        FROM request_context
    ) AS patient_name,

    (
        SELECT mobile
        FROM request_context
    ) AS mobile,

    (
        SELECT clinic_name
        FROM request_context
    ) AS clinic_name,

    (
        SELECT doctor_name
        FROM request_context
    ) AS doctor_name,

    (
        SELECT service_name
        FROM request_context
    ) AS service_name,

    (
        SELECT TO_CHAR(
            starts_at
            AT TIME ZONE timezone,
            'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'
        )
        FROM request_context
    ) AS appointment_start,

    (
        SELECT google_calendar_event_id
        FROM request_context
    ) AS google_calendar_event_id,

    CASE
        WHEN r.response = 'cancel'
            THEN 'delete'

        WHEN r.response = 'reschedule'
            THEN 'find_available_slots'

        ELSE 'none'
    END AS next_action

FROM request_data r;

parameters.content:
## پردازش پاسخ بیمار پیش از مراجعه

توکن را از خروجی Workflow شماره 27 بردار.

**responseهای مجاز:**
- `confirm`: تأیید حضور
- `cancel`: لغو نوبت و حذف Calendar
- `reschedule`: ثبت درخواست جابه‌جایی؛ نوبت فعلی هنوز خودکار تغییر نمی‌کند

برای حالت reschedule، خروجی `next_action=find_available_slots` خواهد بود.

اصلاح V2:
در صورت نبود Calendar Event، وضعیت not_present برگردانده می‌شود.
